titleBack: No One To Stop Us This Time

flipToBack.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToBack.prose: Flip if you control 3 Tatooine sites AND opponent controls fewer than 3 Tatooine sites. Plain control (no actor filter); sites only, system does not count.

flipToFront.timing: RequiredGameTextTriggerAction (singleton) on TriggerConditions.isTableChanged; auto-fires whenever condition holds
flipToFront.prose: Back flips to front if opponent controls MORE Tatooine sites than you (strict count comparison of controlled Tatooine sites).

children.gameConditions: Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.controls(opponent, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE))) > Filters.countTopLocationsOnTable(game, Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.controls(playerId, SpotOverride.INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE)))

requirementSemantics: Front flip = plain CONTROL of 3 Tatooine sites (no actor requirement) with an OPPONENT CONSTRAINT (opponent must control < 3 Tatooine sites). Both checks INCLUDE_EXCLUDED_FROM_BATTLE.
Back flip = RELATIVE COUNT: opponent strictly ahead in controlled Tatooine sites. Equal counts (including 0-0) keep the back up; back is much easier to hold than front was to flip.
No occupy semantics anywhere in the flip laws; system control is irrelevant to flipping.
typedIdentities: Filters.Tatooine_site - flip gate locations both sides (sites, not Tatooine_location)
Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_site, Filters.battleground) - setup 3rd deploy + once-per-turn download (both sides, shared GameTextActionId.IMPERIAL_ENTANGLEMENTS__DOWNLOAD_TATOOINE_BATTLEGROUND_SITE)

Deploy bans (front, until end of game): Filters.or(Filters.Sandwhirl, Filters.Jabbas_Palace_site, Filters.and(Filters.character, Filters.not(Filters.Imperial)), Filters.and(Filters.starship, Filters.not(Filters.Imperial_starship)), Filters.system)
Filters.Admirals_Order - MayNotDeploy while-active on BOTH sides
Filters.Tatooine_Occupation - front shelters opponent from its Force loss
Filters.and(Filters.opponents(self), Filters.character) + Filters.Tatooine_site - back landspeed move tax
Filters.and(Filters.Tatooine_location, Filters.occupies(playerId)) - back peek X counter (locations, occupied)
setupAndPullRoutes: Setup (front, required): deploy Tatooine system from Reserve Deck. Card201_039.java:55-61
Setup (front, required): deploy Devastator to Tatooine system from Reserve Deck. Card201_039.java:62-68
Setup (front, required): deploy a Tatooine site that will be a battleground (DeployCardFromReserveDeckEffect with specialLocationConditions Filters.battleground). Card201_039.java:69-75
Front + back, once per turn: download a Tatooine battleground site from Reserve Deck (same action id both sides). Card201_039.java:103-122; Card201_039_BACK.java:105-121
Back, once during your control phase: peek at top X of Reserve Deck (X = number of Tatooine locations you occupy, capped by deck size), take one into hand, shuffle. Card201_039_BACK.java:57-87
Back, once during your draw phase: retrieve one trooper. Card201_039_BACK.java:89-103
otherObligations: Front (until end of game, after deployment completes): you may not deploy Sandwhirl, Jabba's Palace sites, non-Imperial characters, non-Imperial starships, or systems. Card201_039.java:80-88
Both sides (while active): you may not deploy Admiral's Orders. Card201_039.java:98; Card201_039_BACK.java:132

Front (while this side up): opponent loses no Force to Tatooine Occupation or to your Force drains at Tatooine system (drain there is zero-value while front up - flip before expecting system-drain damage). Card201_039.java:96-97
Back: opponent's characters require +1 Force to move from Tatooine sites using landspeed. Card201_039_BACK.java:131
Strategic: keep controlled-Tatooine-site count >= opponent's to stay on back; deck restricted to Imperial characters/starships and no additional systems for the rest of the game.

profile.frontStructuredRule: preFlip/flip allOf: self controls >=3 Tatooine_site and opponent controls <3 Tatooine_site
profile.backStructuredRule: postFlip/flipBack allOf: opponent-controlled Tatooine_site count > self-controlled count
profile.nativeRoute: Exact objective action deploys only a currently legal Tatooine battleground site and excludes Jabba's Palace sites.

behaviorProof.frontRoute: Both bots preserve the next route site and final body through real Force loss, use the exact native site download, battle for the starting gate site, leave an anchor, move a route actor, pull the remaining site on turn two, deploy the final body there, and observe the unchanged objective flip.
behaviorProof.completionBoundary: The final third-site deployment receives a narrow +8000 completion score that defeats the legacy low-ability ground penalty and ordinary ship alternative only when the exact destination completes this three-site gate. Hard vetoes remain dominant.
behaviorProof.backRoute: At self count <= opponent count + 1, both bots use the free back-side Tatooine battleground route before the strict relative count slips. The exact parent gets +1800 and the legal child gets +300.
behaviorProof.sourceBoundary: The route may bypass the two-card V60 reserve-risk veto only from the actual physical objective with the exact action and a legal candidate. Wrong action, wrong source, same-blueprint counterfeit, safely-ahead state, and exhausted route receive no exception.
behaviorProof.parity: Rando and Chosen One return identical scores, reasoning, and winners across the audited decisions.
behaviorProof.verification: Focused MBO/IE and shared deploy, pull, Force-loss, battle-forfeit, and analyzer regression gates pass. JSON validation and diff checks pass.
behaviorProof.deployment: Local behavior commit bd41a399b is live in host/container-matching web.jar SHA-256 3ea3c6542438a4d2f4617bbb7a58a4af876f103d75029efbf7986e9dff6cb3ba after a zero-table freeze and fresh JVM start. The prior jar is preserved as web.jar.pre-mbo-ie-bd41a399b.
behaviorProof.replay: No live replay claim. Deterministic unchanged-engine tests provide FLIP_OBSERVED.

Live server branch firing and replay observation remain separate proof gates.
